description.p: RatPoison is a high-performance, memory-safe Rust + Tauri v2 keyboard-driven mouse replacement utility inspired by Mouseless.

ul.li: Two-stage recursive Grid and Subgrid cursor targeting across multi-monitor setups
Continuous Free Mode ballistic cursor control with spring-damper physics
OS Accessibility Tree Label Mode (AT-SPI2, macOS AXUIElement, Windows UIAutomation) with prefix-free home-row hint badges
Wayland XDG Desktop Portal (GlobalShortcuts and RemoteDesktop) and uinput virtual HID support

description.p: Wire native global keyboard hooks (Option+Space, Option+Shift+Space, Option+F), fix macOS Label Mode accessibility scanning, add Free Mode immediate tap stepping, and show an in-app macOS Accessibility permission banner.
Initial cross-platform release with Grid Mode, Free Mode, and Accessibility Tree Label Mode.
